findings.explanation: 'checkpoint' (firewall vendor) is tagged as equipment for a Customer Effort Score (CES) and ITSM support analytics use case.
The description alert condition contains disconnected raw eval fragments instead of explaining that composite customer effort scores are aggregated across channels and categories.
findings.suggested_fix: Describe the actual analysis: the search computes an omnichannel effort index (combining normalized CES survey ratings, reassignments, channel switching, and repeated contacts) to identify high-friction support channels.

findings.explanation: Marked verified despite containing template residue and incorrect equipment metadata.

summary: Implementation procedures and domain troubleshooting guidance are outstanding, but description has templated threshold fragments, equipment includes unrelated firewall hardware (checkpoint), and control tests are heavily templated.
